artificialIntelligence.title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
artificialIntelligence.description: Turn complex data into intelligent action through AI solutions designed around your organisation’s operations and objectives.
detailedDescription: iTechs Arabia develops customised artificial intelligence products that help organisations automate complex processes, uncover patterns and make faster, data-driven decisions.

By combining machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, predictive analytics and geospatial intelligence, we transform operational data into practical tools that support users across different departments and levels of decision-making.

Our AI products are designed around each organisation’s existing systems, workflows and data environment. They can operate independently or integrate with dashboards, command-and-control platforms, GIS applications, enterprise systems and IoT infrastructure.

planningTrainingSimulation.title: PLANNING, TRAINING & SIMULATION
planningTrainingSimulation.description: Plan smarter, train realistically and validate critical decisions before they are implemented in the field.
detailedDescription: The iTechs Arabia Planning, Training & Simulation platform is a geospatially enabled system developed to support planning, terrain analysis, scenario development, training and performance evaluation.

The platform allows officers, commanders and trainees to study terrain, assess tactical conditions and compare different operational alternatives within a secure digital environment. Plans can be developed, visualised and simulated before implementation, allowing users to evaluate their effectiveness and understand the potential consequences of each decision.

The system also supports decision-makers across strategic, operational and tactical levels by creating a centralised information environment that can integrate with existing or future systems. Its flexible architecture enables the platform to evolve alongside operational requirements and emerging technologies.

workforceManagement.title: WORKFORCE MANAGEMENT
workforceManagement.description: Turn every request, task and field team into one connected, visible and measurable service operation.
detailedDescription: iTechs Arabia’s Workforce Management platform connects service requests, supervisors, field teams and operational data within one unified digital environment.

The platform enables organisations to receive requests, assign tasks, monitor employees and contractors, track service progress and verify completion in real time. Through GIS-enabled dispatching, mobile workforce applications and centralised dashboards, managers gain full visibility over who is working, where they are located and how effectively each task is being completed.

Our business analysts work closely with every client to understand their existing processes, identify operational gaps and map the complete service journey. Based on this analysis, we configure the platform’s workflows, task categories, escalation rules, performance indicators and dashboards to match the organisation’s actual requirements rather than forcing teams to follow a standardised process.

artilleryTacticalOperationNavigation.title: ARTILLERY TACTICAL OPERATION NAVIGATION
artilleryTacticalOperationNavigation.description: A connected artillery planning, navigation and fire-control environment designed to strengthen coordination, visibility and operational precision.
detailedDescription: Artillery Tactical Operation & Navigation, or ATON, is an integrated artillery planning, management and fire-control platform developed to support the coordination of artillery units and assets within one secure operational environment.

The system connects commanders, platoon leaders, forward observers and weapon units, enabling them to exchange operational information and maintain a shared understanding of missions, assets, terrain and field conditions.

ATON combines geospatial analysis, artillery asset management, mission planning, navigation, fire-control support and operational reporting. It helps commanders assess terrain, identify appropriate positions and routes, coordinate available resources and maintain visibility over developing operations.
